summary: Iteration-3 backend testing of major TMS upgrades — new Input Order fields, Rekonsiliasi cost guard, Bulk Invoice, Bulk Mark-Paid w/ payment_invoice_number+paid_date, Marketing as separate COGS (5104), Panjar Kerja (Cash Advance) module incl. settle+delete RBAC, Tax options (0/1/11/12%), and Contract via field. All 19 new test cases pass (100%).

minor.issue: Customers/contracts collections were EMPTY when this iteration started — backend lifespan seeding appears to be idempotent + skipped or DB was reset between iterations. Reports in iter_1/2 mentioned 3 customers and 4 contracts already present; now there are 0. Tests work around it by creating their own TEST_Customer, but main agent should verify whether seeding logic still runs / a deliberate reset endpoint was triggered.

action_items: Verify the backend lifespan seed (3 customers / 4 contracts / 5 AWBs etc.) still runs on this DB or document that a manual reset wiped it — otherwise the frontend will load empty.

Consider adding `data-testid` for the new Input Order fields (awb_number, reff_no, pickup_date, service, via, status_pengiriman, koli_count, koli_qty_per, armada, driver_name, nopol, insurance_*) to support frontend automation in future iterations.

PATCH /api/orders/{oid}/extended currently uses `if v is not None` to filter — empty strings are still saved (e.g. clearing `reff_no` by passing '' will set it to ''). If the spec wants clearing fields to set null, add `or v == ''` handling.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to 4021 lines — strongly recommend splitting into routers/{orders,costs,invoices,payments,cash_advances,reports,settings}.py before adding more modules.
create_order (L871) ignores `insurance_amount` when `insurance_enabled=False` (sets to 0). That is fine but the PATCH /extended path stores raw value without that gating — small inconsistency.
bulk_mark_paid (L1286) swallows post_journal HTTPException silently; mark_paid (L1242) returns journal_warning in body. Inconsistent — pick one strategy.
Cash advance: settle_cash_advance also swallows journal exceptions silently. If 5105/1108 accounts are missing the financials would silently break — at minimum log it.
GET /api/cash-advances query param is `status_v` — frontend usually sends `status`. Confirm contract.
next_awb_number / next_cash_advance_number use string-sort regex lookup; safe for ≤9999 / month. Fine for MVP.
test_credentials: admin/admin123, operation/operation123, finance/finance123 — all verified working
seed_data_creation: Auto-creates TEST_Customer when /api/customers is empty (fresh env handling). Test data uses TEST_ prefix where applicable. Several Open/Reconciled/Invoiced/Paid AWBs created during this run that may persist; consider DB reset before re-running.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iteration3_features.py is the canonical regression suite for the new Order/Reconcile/Invoice/Payment/Panjar/Marketing/Tax/Contract-via features. It runs in ~8s with 0 failures against a clean or stale DB (auto-creates a customer if none). Combine with existing test_tms_backend.py and test_modules_backend.py for full coverage. The pre-existing iteration-2 bug (GET /api/reports/balance-sheet balanced=false) was NOT re-tested in this iteration as it's out of scope.
rca_of_the_issue: Initial test failures (13 errors) were caused by empty customers collection (DB had no seed data on this run), not by app bugs. After making the first_customer fixture self-provisioning, all 19 cases pass and confirm the spec: AWB unique constraint (400 on dup), auto AWB when omitted (AWB-YYYYMM-XXXX), pickup_date drives created_at, status_pengiriman='' normalized to null, Marketing cost role-restricted to admin/finance, reconcile requires ≥1 cost (skipped_no_cost counter, 400 when none qualify), PATCH /extended performs recalc + uniqueness check + 403 for non-admin on non-Open AWB, bulk invoice returns created_count/skipped_count, mark-paid persists payment_invoice_number and uses paid_date for paid_at, bulk-mark-paid likewise, Panjar Kerja PNJ-YYYYMM-XXXX number gen, settle flips Open→Settled with actual+refund, delete enforced admin-only (403 for finance).
